reden: Yes. The report repeatedly flags the same issue in AssignmentHook.onBlockProposed: ERC20 fees are taken via safeTransferFrom(_meta.coinbase, assignedProver, fee) while _meta.coinbase is freely set by the proposer in LibProposing.proposeBlock and is not required to equal msg.sender. This lets a proposer set coinbase to a victim address that has approved AssignmentHook, forcing the victim to pay the prover’s fee. The attack path and impact match the description, and the same fix (bind payer to msg.sender or otherwise enforce/prove coinbase) would resolve both.
